# Muse tool interface

Every call is `{action, data}`. Muse fills IDs, keys, next checks and managed revisions; errors name the field.

## `muse_manage`

Hermes Muse: goals, interests, ideas, preferences, watches, Feed, notes and calendar for the user of this private conversation. Arguments go inside data. Muse fills IDs, keys and next checks; only content_write and content forget take an expected_revision (from read).

### `goal_create` (write)

Create a goal the user accepted in this conversation; same title twice returns the existing goal.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | required | string; ≤200 chars |
| `criteria` | required | string; ≤4000 chars — what done looks like |
| `deadline` |  | string; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:00:00+08:00 (no offset: profile time) |
| `parent_id` |  | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `no_fade` |  | boolean — only on the user's explicit request |

### `goal_update` (write)

Change a goal for the user: status, waiting, deadline, owner or a progress note. status=done needs evidence. Any update moves the next check to tomorrow unless next_check_at is given.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `goal_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `title` |  | string; ≤200 chars |
| `status` |  | active / done / cancelled |
| `evidence` |  | string; ≤1000 chars — a link, commit, file path or one checkable observation that shows it is done |
| `waiting_user` |  | boolean |
| `deadline` |  | string/null; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:00:00+08:00 (no offset: profile time) |
| `no_fade` |  | boolean |
| `owner` |  | string/null; ≤200 chars — native delegation handle now working on it |
| `next_check_at` |  | string; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:00:00+08:00 (no offset: profile time) |
| `progress_note` |  | string; ≤1000 chars |

### `assignment_record` (write)

Record an executor you started for an open goal, so it is followed up; native is Hermes' own delegation, others come from RULES.md.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `goal_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `executor` | required | string; ≤100 chars |
| `handle` | required | string; ≤200 chars — what starting the executor returned |
| `expected_end` |  | string; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:00:00+08:00 (no offset: profile time) |
| `note` |  | string; ≤1000 chars |

### `assignment_update` (write)

Change an assignment for the user: their answer resumes it (running), or it is stopped, done (conclusion and evidence) or failed (conclusion).

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `assignment_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `state` | required | running / waiting / done / failed / stalled / stopped |
| `conclusion` |  | string; ≤2000 chars |
| `evidence` |  | string; ≤1000 chars |
| `expected_end` |  | string; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:00:00+08:00 (no offset: profile time) |

### `interest_record` (write)

Remember a temporary interest (Feed and patrol use it); 14 days unless expires.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | required | string; ≤200 chars |
| `rationale` |  | string; ≤2000 chars |
| `expires` |  | string; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:00:00+08:00 (no offset: profile time) |

Keep an idea for later; 14 days unless expires.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | required | string; ≤200 chars |
| `rationale` |  | string; ≤2000 chars |

### `preferences` (write)

Change proactive preferences; pause_jobs=true pauses every Muse job (after installation_prepare and the user's confirmation).

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `start_hour` |  | integer; 0–23 |
| `end_hour` |  | integer; 0–24 |
| `ordinary_per_day` |  | integer/null; 0–50 |
| `time_sensitive_per_day` |  | integer/null; 0–50 |
| `urgent_per_day` |  | integer; 0–50 — urgent notices that may skip quiet hours per day; more are sent as time_sensitive |
| `blocked_topics` |  | array |
| `deliver` |  | string/null; ≤200 chars — route of the muse-deliver job (notices), e.g. bot-chat or telegram; applied from its next run, null keeps the job's route |
| `goal_dormant_days` |  | integer/null; 1–365 |
| `goal_fade_days` |  | integer/null; 1–365 |
| `fade_question` |  | string/null; ≤500 chars — dormancy question in the user's language with {title}, {days}, {date} |
| `weather_context` |  | boolean — allow weather checks for known plans (uses the user's location) |
| `notes` |  | string; ≤8000 chars — free-text body of PROACTIVE_PREFERENCES.md: coverage scope, topics to avoid, Feed brief |
| `pause_jobs` |  | boolean |

### `feedback` (write)

The user's reaction to a notice, interest, idea or review finding; stop ends an interest/idea and withdraws an unsent notice.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | required | notice / interest / idea / finding |
| `id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `value` | required | useful / not_useful / stop |
| `note` |  | string; ≤500 chars |

| `id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `expected_revision` |  | string; ≤80 chars |

### `watch_create` (write)

Watch something for an open goal on a schedule; the run reports only when the stop condition is met or something changed.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `goal_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `schedule` | required | string; ≤100 chars — Hermes cron schedule, e.g. every 2h or 0 9 * * * |
| `prompt` | required | string; ≤4000 chars — what to check and how |
| `stop_condition` | required | string; ≤1000 chars |
| `expires` |  | string; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-02T18:00:00+08:00 (no offset: profile time) |

### `watch_stop` (write)

Stop a watch.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `watch_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |

### `content_write` (write)

Write a note, person/group page, dream, alignment, TOOLS.md, AGENTS.md, RULES.md, DECISIONS.md or goal file; read it first for its revision ('absent' when new).

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | required | note / dream / alignment / tools_note / working_lessons / goal_file / rules / decisions |
| `id` | required | string; ≤200 chars |
| `body` | required | string; ≤60000 chars |
| `expected_revision` | required | string; ≤80 chars |

### `read` (read)

Read Muse state: one entity or file by id, or a list (query filters, newest first). Text pages at 12k characters: pass next_offset as offset. kind=status gives health and counts.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | required | status / goal / assignment / notice / finding / feed / interest / idea / watch / source / signal / note / dream / alignment / tools_note / working_lessons / preferences / goal_file / rules / decisions |
| `id` |  | string; ≤200 chars |
| `query` |  | string; ≤200 chars |
| `limit` |  | integer; 1–100 |
| `offset` |  | integer; 0–10000000 |

### `calendar_view` (read)

Without window: the window for mode. With that window unchanged plus sources: the merged schedule.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` |  | rolling / month |
| `window` |  | object — returned by calendar_view |
| `sources` |  | array — see the calendar reference |
| `discovery_complete` |  | boolean |

### `installation_prepare` (read)

Read-only plan for disabling or removing Muse: owned jobs and the confirmed steps.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `operation` | required | disable / remove |

## `muse_job`

Hermes Muse job runs only: read, observe and submit against the packet in this run's Script Output. Arguments go inside data; refs come from the packet.

### `read` (read)

Original text of a packet item beyond its excerpt (12k per call, 24k per item).

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `packet_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `ref` | required | string; ≤200 chars |
| `offset` |  | integer; 0–10000000 |

### `observe` (write)

Record one source check of a patrol packet with the items seen (upstream IDs as the source gives them).

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `packet_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `source_id` | required | string; ≤64 chars — <kind>:<account>, e.g. mail:work, calendar:home |
| `items` | required | array; of {upstream_id, title*, ts, url} |
| `limitation_code` |  | string; ≤64 chars — a stable code when the source could only be read partly |
| `error` |  | string; ≤300 chars — the source could not be read |

### `submit` (write)

Results for packet items, one per item; the packet's schema lists the shapes. Idempotent per item.

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `packet_id` | required | string; ≤200 chars — an id returned by Muse |
| `results` | required | array |

## submit result shapes

One result per packet item. The packet's `schema` names the shapes its items take.

### intake

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `ref` | required | string — a ref from this packet |
| `disposition` | required | saved / ignored / context |
| `facts` |  | array |
| `goal_hint` |  | string — an open goal id, or 'new' to propose a goal |

### patrol

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `candidate_ref` | required | string — a ref from this packet |
| `verdict` | required | send / skip / withdraw / supersede / dispatch / forwarded |
| `text` |  | string; ≤2000 chars |
| `priority` |  | urgent / time_sensitive / ordinary |
| `topic` |  | string; ≤100 chars — short topic label; the exact context.blocked_topics entry when the item is about one |
| `about` |  | string — a context.notified ref: the notified event this item is about |
| `handle` |  | string; ≤200 chars — dispatch: what the executor's run template returned |
| `executor` |  | string; ≤100 chars — dispatch: the rule's executor |
| `expected_end` |  | string; ≤40 chars — dispatch: ISO 8601, only when the executor gave an estimate; otherwise the rule's expect applies |

### goals

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `goal_id` |  | string — a ref from this packet |
| `assessment` |  | on_track / stalled / blocked / done_suggested |
| `progress_note` |  | string |
| `evidence` |  | string; ≤1000 chars — done_suggested: a link, commit, file path or checkable observation |
| `text` |  | string; ≤2000 chars — done_suggested: your question to the user |
| `create` |  | object |
| `decline` |  | object |

### review

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `candidate_ref` | required | string — a ref from this packet |
| `verdict` | required | agent_gap / latent_need / friction / fine |
| `reason` | required | string; ≤500 chars |

### feed

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `interest_ref` | required | string — a ref from this packet |
| `article` |  | object |
| `notice` |  | object |

### assignment

| field | | type |
|---|---|---|
| `assignment_ref` | required | string — a ref from this packet |
| `state` | required | running / waiting / done / failed / stalled |
| `conclusion` |  | string; ≤2000 chars — what it found or did, in your own words to the user; required for done and failed, and for running past its expected end |
| `evidence` |  | string; ≤1000 chars — done: a link, commit, file path or checkable observation |
| `question` |  | string; ≤2000 chars — waiting or failed: the decision for the user, your recommendation, why, and the options |
| `expected_end` |  | string; ≤40 chars — ISO 8601, only when the executor gave a new estimate |

## Content kinds

| kind | id |
|---|---|
| `note` | daily:YYYY-MM-DD, person:<name> or group:<name> |
| `dream` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `alignment` | current |
| `tools_note` | current (TOOLS.md) |
| `working_lessons` | current (AGENTS.md) |
| `preferences` | current (read only; change it with preferences) |
| `goal_file` | <goal id>/<name>.md |
| `rules` | current (RULES.md: first-line JSON with executors and rules; a broken one is refused) |
| `decisions` | current (DECISIONS.md: what the user decided, in their words; read it before asking again) |
